{{Header Nav|game=The Legend of Zelda}} 

This walkthrough uses the following notation throughout each quest.
*This is a mandatory task that must be completed before any of the tasks listed below it.
**This is an optional task that is listed at the earliest time that it becomes possible to complete.
There are many things that are immediately available to you in the [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld|Overworld]] before you even set foot in the [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld|Underworld]].  You may choose to take advantage of that fact early in your quest, or wait until you have grown a little stronger instead.

For both quests, having the bommerang received in level 1 will make navigation in the overworld much easier. Almost every enemy, especially the lynels, can be stunned while you proceed to the next area.

You are not required to complete the levels in their numerical order.  You can enter any dungeon at any time, provided you have the proper means to access it.  The order listed below is merely one suggested approach.

After you beat the game for the first time, you will have completed the first quest. If you continue your game afterwards, you will begin the second quest.

==1st Quest Overview==
*Collect the wooden sword from the cave immediately visible from your starting position in the lower right corner of [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 6|section six]].
**Earn 60 rupees and purchase the Blue Candle.
**Earn enough rupees (160, 130, or 90 if you have the Blue Candle and uncover one of the secret shops) to purchase the Magic Shield.
**Collect some bombs and obtain the heart containers found in the lowest row of [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 4|section four]] and the giant boulder in [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 1|section one]].
**Use the Blue Candle to burn one of the trees in the upper right corner of [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 6|section six]] in order to collect another heart container.
**Once you have at least 5 total heart containers, head to the cave above the waterfall in [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 3|section three]] to obtain the White Sword.
**Travel through the [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 8|Lost Woods]] and the [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 7|cemetery]] to reach an area in [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 5|section five]] where you can discover the Power Bracelet which will allow you to use the secret passageways found in [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 7|section seven]], [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 4|section four]], and [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 1|section one]].
**Save up 250 rupees to buy the Blue Ring from the hidden shop located in the top left corner of [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 6|section six]].
**Earn 80 rupees and purchase wooden arrows.
**Obtain the letter from the old man in [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 1|section one]] and then show it to any of the medicine women in order to purchase the Water of Life.
*Locate and enter [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 1|level 1]] and collect the Bow, defeat Aquamentus to earn a Heart Container, and recover the first piece of the Triforce.
**Collect the wooden boomerang in [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 1|level 1]].
*Locate and enter [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 2|level 2]] and defeat Dodongo to earn a Heart Container, and recover the second piece of the Triforce.
**Collect the magic boomerang in [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 2|level 2]].
*Locate and enter [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 3|level 3]] and collect the raft, defeat Manhandla to earn a Heart Container, and recover the third piece of the Triforce.
**Use the raft to collect the heart container found on the island in [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 1|section one]].
*Locate and enter [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 4|level 4]] and collect the ladder, defeat a two headed Gleeok to earn a Heart Container, and recover the fourth piece of the Triforce.
**Use the ladder to collect the heart container found on the far out dock in [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 2|section two]].
**Once you have at least 12 total heart containers, head to the upper right corner of the [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 7|cemetery]] and locate the movable tombstone to obtain the Magic Sword.
*Locate and enter [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 5|level 5]] and collect the Whistle, defeat Digdogger to earn a Heart Container, and recover the fifth piece of the Triforce.
**Increase your bomb carrying capacity in [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 5|level 5]] for 100 rupees
*If you haven't done so already, you must purchase arrows in order to defeat Gohma in [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 6|level 6]].
*Locate and enter [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 6|level 6]] and defeat Ghoma to earn a Heart Container, and recover the sixth piece of the Triforce.
**Collect the Magic Wand in [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 6|level 6]].
*If you haven't done so already, you must purchase Monster Bait for the hungry Moblin located in [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 7|level 7]].
*Locate and enter [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 7|level 7]] and feed the hungry Moblin, defeat Aquamentus to earn a Heart Container, and recover the seventh piece of the Triforce.
**Collect the Red Candle in [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 7|level 7]].
**Increase your bomb carrying capacity in [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 7|level 7]]
*Using a red or blue candle, locate and enter [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 8|level 8]] and defeat a four headed Gleeok to earn a Heart Container, and recover the final piece of the Triforce.
**Collect the Magic Book and the Magic Key in [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 8|level 8]]
*Locate and enter [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 9|level 9]] at Spectacle Rock in [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 5|Death Mountain]] and collect the Silver Arrows.
**Collect the Red Ring in [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 9|level 9]].
*Locate and defeat Ganon in [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 9|level 9]] and save Princess Zelda.

==2nd Quest Overview==
;Note: The whistle is far more important in the 2nd Quest than the 1st Quest due to its power to reveal more secrets in the Overworld, including the locations of two heart containers.  It may be worth your time to try and obtain it from [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 2|level 2]] before proceeding to [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 1|level 1]].  That will enable you to get the White Sword before you enter [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 1|level 1]].  Likewise, if you are brave, attempt to obtain the ladder from [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 6|level 6]] before or after entering [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 4|level 4]].  That will enable you to obtain the Magic Sword before you enter [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 5|level 5]].
*Collect the wooden sword from the cave immediately visible from your starting position in the lower right corner of [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 6|section six]].
**Earn 60 rupees and purchase the Blue Candle.
**Earn enough rupees (160, 130, or 90 if you have the Blue Candle and uncover one of the secret shops) to purchase the Magic Shield.
**Travel through the [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 8|Lost Woods]] and to the [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 7|cemetery]] and go to the north west corner of the cemetery.  Push the second tombstone from the left in the middle row to find a man who offers Link a Heart Container.
**Travel through the [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 8|Lost Woods]] and the [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 7|cemetery]] to reach an area in [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 5|section five]] where you can discover the Power Bracelet which will allow you to use the secret passageways found in [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 7|section seven]], [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 4|section four]], and [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 1|section one]].
**Save up 250 rupees to buy the Blue Ring from the hidden shop located in the north east corner of [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 1|section one]].
**Earn 80 rupees and purchase wooden arrows.
**Obtain the letter from the old man in the hidden staircase in [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 7|section seven]] and then show it to any of the medicine women in order to purchase the Water of Life.
*Locate and enter [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 1|level 1]] and defeat Aquamentus to earn a Heart Container, and recover the first piece of the Triforce.
**Collect the wooden boomerang in [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 1|level 1]].
*Locate and enter [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 2|level 2]] and obtain the Whistle, defeat Gleeok to earn a Heart Container, and recover the second piece of the Triforce.
**Once you have at least 5 total heart containers, head to the cave above the waterfall in [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 3|section three]] to obtain the White Sword.
**Use the whistle in the north east corner of the desert to reveal a staircase where a man offers Link a Heart Container.
**Use the whistle in the area just right of Spectacle Rock in [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 5|section five]] to reveal a staircase where a man offers Link a Heart Container.
*Locate and enter [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 3|level 3]] using the whistle, defeat Manhandla to earn a Heart Container, and recover the third piece of the Triforce.
**Collect the magic boomerang in [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 3|level 3]].  (You will need to purchase Monster Bait)
*If you haven't done so already, collect the Power Bracelet, located past the cemetery in [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 5|section five]]. 
*Locate and enter [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 4|level 4]] and defeat Digdogger to earn a Heart Container, collect the raft, and recover the fourth piece of the Triforce.
**Collect the magic book in [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 4|level 4]].
**Increase your bomb carrying capacity in [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 4|level 4]]
**Use the raft to collect the heart container found on the island in [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 1|section one]].
*Locate and enter [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 5|level 5]] and collect the Bow, defeat a three headed Gleeok to earn a Heart Container, and recover the fifth piece of the Triforce.
**Once you have at least 12 total heart containers, head to the area of [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 3|section three]] where the boulders are shaped like an arrow.  Push the left boulder to obtain the Magic Sword.
*If you haven't done so already, you must purchase arrows in order to defeat Ghoma in [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 6|level 6]].
*Locate and enter [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 6|level 6]] and obtain the ladder, defeat Ghoma to earn a Heart Container, and recover the sixth piece of the Triforce.
**Use the ladder to collect the heart container found on the far out dock in [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 2|section two]].
*Locate and enter [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 7|level 7]] and feed the hungry Moblin, defeat a four headed Gleeok to earn a Heart Container, and recover the seventh piece of the Triforce.
**Collect the Red Candle in [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 7|level 7]].
*If you haven't done so already, you must purchase Monster Bait for the hungry Moblin located in [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 8|level 8]].
*Locate and enter [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 8|level 8]] and defeat a four headed Gleeok to earn a Heart Container, and recover the final piece of the Triforce.
**Collect the Magic Wand and the Magic Key in [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 8|level 8]]
**Increase your bomb carrying capacity in [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 8|level 8]]
*Locate and enter [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 9|level 9]] in the north west corner of [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 7|section seven]] and collect the Silver Arrows.
**Collect the Red Ring in [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 9|level 9]].
*Locate and defeat Ganon in [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 2/Dungeon 9|level 9]] and save Princess Zelda.
